snippet.title: The Twisted Tales of Spike McFang (SNES) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A complete playthrough of Bullet Proof Software's 1994 Super NES action RPG, The Twisted Tales of Spike McFang. 

This is the only game of the three "Spike McFang" games that Red released in English. The first title, Makai Prince Dorabocchan (translates roughly as "Prince of Hell Thief-chan") was a TG16 platformer, Spike McFang (or Chou Makai Taisen! Dorabocchan / Super Demon Wars! Thief-chan) was the first SNES release, and the final of the set, Naxat Open Golf de Shoubo Dorabocchan (shoubu is a contest or a duel), also for the SNES, was a fairly bizarre but totally enjoyable golf game featuring the Spike characters. 

But for the game at hand - there are three "jumps" in the video that you'll notice if you watch it through - once in the mountains, once in the pyramid, and once in the ice palace. These jumps were edits to cut out most of the level grinding (since it's really not that great for viewing ;). Before the edits, the level grinding added another 2.5 hours or so onto the game's time.
_____
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
